subject: Final task: systems + inference exercise — instructions, deadline, and reviewer schedule
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodelite.com>
To: Jordan Park <jordan.park@example.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodelite.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodelite.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodelite.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 08:00:00 -0700
Subject: Final task: systems + inference exercise — instructions, deadline, and reviewer schedule

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for taking the time to interview with Redwood Inference. As discussed, attached is the final take-home exercise we use for senior infra/serving candidates. The exercise is intentionally open-ended — focus on clarity of constraints, trade-offs, and a short design write-up plus a short runnable snippet (if you prefer Python).

Deliverables (one PDF or a plain repo link):
- Design write-up (1–2 pages): architecture, latency/cost trade-offs, fallback policy, and data privacy considerations.
- Short evaluation script or pseudo-code showing request routing and caching logic (10–40 LOC ok).
- Optional: short notes on quantization/throughput knobs you would use in production.

Deadline: Wednesday, Apr 14, 2027, 11:59pm PT. If you need extra time, let me know — we can usually grant a 48-hour extension on request.

Attachments: candidate_project_brief.pdf (problem statement + sample dataset) — also available here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B_candidate_prompt_2027

Next steps and reviewers:
- We’ll confirm receipt and then schedule a 30-minute review slot where one of our infra engineers will walk through the submission with you (no live coding).
- Reviewer pool: Marcus Lin and Monica Patel. Review slots are available Thu 4/15 and Fri 4/16 — I’ll follow up to lock a time after you submit.

Please reply to confirm you received the materials and that the deadline works.

Best,
Irene Choi
Recruiting Partner, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: candidate_project_brief.pdf)
From: Jordan Park <jordan.park@example.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodelite.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final task: systems + inference exercise — instructions, deadline, and reviewer schedule

Hi Irene,

Got it — thanks for sending. The prompt looks clear. I confirm I received candidate_project_brief.pdf and the Drive link. The deadline on 4/14 works for me. I’ll send the submission via PDF and include a small GitHub repo link if there’s runnable code.

If anything changes I’ll flag it early. Looking forward to it.

Thanks,
Jordan

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodelite.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodelite.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodelite.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodelite.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Final task: systems + inference exercise — instructions, deadline, and reviewer schedule

Team — quick ops note now that Jordan has confirmed receipt. We need to lock reviewer slots and agree who takes the primary read. Summary: candidate submits by Wed 4/14 11:59pm PT, we’ll do a 30-minute review session the following week. Prefer to keep reviews compact and consistent: 15m individual read + 30m sync with candidate (shared).

Proposed reviewer schedule (please reply with the slot you can take):
- Thu 4/15 10:00–10:30 PT — Marcus available (tentative)
- Thu 4/15 14:00–14:30 PT — Monica available (tentative)
- Fri 4/16 09:00–09:30 PT — backup slot

Actions:
- Marcus: if you can own the primary read and lead the 30m candidate call, reply with CONFIRM.
- Monica: please confirm if the 2pm slot works or if you prefer Fri 9.
- Mina: I’ll need a short rubric to standardize scoring — can you attach the rubric.xlsx by EOD today?

I’m attaching a draft reviewer rubric and the calendar invite template (calendar_invite.ics). Once reviewers claim a slot I’ll send the invite to Jordan and include a short pre-read (your assigned section).

Thanks — Irene
(Attachment: review_rubric.xlsx, calendar_invite.ics)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodelite.com>

Irene — I’ll block 9:30–10:30 locally to give myself a buffer.

Thanks,
Marcus

Hi Jordan — quick confirmation. Marcus will be your primary reviewer and we’ve tentatively scheduled the review call for Thu, Apr 15 at 10:00am PT. I’ll send the official calendar invite after you upload your submission.

Checklist for submission:
- Single PDF (design write-up + evaluation notes) OR GitHub repo link (please include a runnable README).
- Filename format: LastName_FirstName_RedwoodTakehome.pdf or GitHub link in the PDF.

If you need extra time, reply directly — we can extend by 48 hours, no problem. Otherwise, see you (virtually) on the 15th if all goes to plan.

Best,
Irene

(Attachments referenced: candidate_project_brief.pdf, review_rubric.xlsx, calendar_invite.ics)
